title: A larva and an adult
hook: Two stages can look like different animals.

knows: Animals can have structures and life stages that differ from humans.
doesNotKnow: The two panels show a free-swimming, tailed larva and an attached adult. Sea squirt larvae and adults differ in form; the diagram omits metamorphosis and does not imply all individuals are found in these states at once.

misconception: The observations in this scenario require a different interpretation.
objective: In the illustrated life cycle of a sea squirt, which stage has a tail used during a free-swimming phase?
